prompt_template.WHAT: A monochrome-style faction emblem. No characters, no setting. Pure iconography.
prompt_template.STYLE: Single-colour emblem against a charcoal background. ASHFALL palette. Limited accent.
prompt_template.COMPOSITION: Emblem symmetrically placed in a square canvas.
prompt_template.PALETTE: charcoal #2A2A2C, concrete grey #5C5F62, faded blue-grey #708085, rust brown #6E4A2F, dirty bone #B5A88A. Accents limited to muted amber #A26E2C (1-2% of pixels) and subtle cyan-green #4F7461 only for contamination iconography.
prompt_template.BACKGROUND: Charcoal or near-black background. No horizon.
prompt_template.RUNTIME_READABILITY: Reads at 64×64 roster chip. Silhouette retains meaning at 32×32.
prompt_template.NEGATIVE: no real-world text, letters, or numerals; no logos or watermark; no AI signature glyphs; no anime-style eyes outside portrait family; no fantasy ornament or fleurons; no neon cyberpunk glow borders; no glossy 3D chromatic rendering; no crystalline particles; no stock-photo backdrop; no pristine factory-fresh finish on tools or weapons; no gratuitous gore; no real-country flags; no real brand marks.
